import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] A = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] B = new char[15][15];
    static int[] di = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dj = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][] layerIdx = new int[65][15][15];
    static int[][] timeDist = new int[15][15];
    static int nextId = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;

        Edge(int u_, int v_, long c) {
            u = u_;
            v = v_;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int n;
        List<Edge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] depth;
        int[] start;

        Dinic(int N) {
            n = N;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            depth = new int[N];
            start = new int[N];
        }

        void link(int u, int v, long c) {
            if (u == v) return;
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, c));
            adj.get(u).add(edges.size() - 1);
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean levelGraph(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(depth, n + 1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            depth[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == t) break;
                for (int idx : adj.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && depth[e.v] > depth[e.u] + 1) {
                        depth[e.v] = depth[e.u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return depth[t] <= n;
        }

        long augment(int u, int t, long bottleneck) {
            if (u == t || bottleneck == 0) return bottleneck;
            for (int i = start[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                start[u] = i;
                Edge e = edges.get(adj.get(u).get(i));
                if (depth[e.v] == depth[e.u] + 1) {
                    long available = e.cap - e.flow;
                    if (bottleneck != -1 && available > bottleneck) available = bottleneck;
                    long pushed = augment(e.v, t, available);
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        edges.get(adj.get(u).get(i) ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (levelGraph(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(start, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = augment(s, t, -1)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                timeDist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                A[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t <= T + 1; t++) {
            for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
                for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                    layerIdx[t][r][c] = nextId++;
                }
            }
        }
        nextId++;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                B[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    timeDist[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int y = cell[0], x = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ny = y + di[d], nx = x + dj[d];
                if (ny >= 1 && ny <= N && nx >= 1 && nx <= N && A[ny][nx] != 'Y' && timeDist[ny][nx] == -1) {
                    timeDist[ny][nx] = timeDist[y][x] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                if (timeDist[i][j] == -1) timeDist[i][j] = 1000000000;
                if (timeDist[i][j] > T) timeDist[i][j] = 1000000000;
            }
        }
        
        int source = 0;
        int sink = nextId - 1;
        Dinic network = new Dinic(nextId);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] >= '1' && A[i][j] <= '9') {
                    network.link(source, layerIdx[0][i][j], A[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Y' || A[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ny = i + di[d], nj = j + dj[d];
                    if (ny >= 1 && ny <= N && nj >= 1 && nj <= N && A[ny][nj] != 'Y' && A[ny][nj] != 'Z') {
                        for (int step = 0; step < T; step++) {
                            if (timeDist[ny][nj] >= step + 1 && timeDist[i][j] > step) {
                                network.link(layerIdx[step][i][j], layerIdx[step + 1][ny][nj], 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Y' || A[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int step = 0; step <= T; step++) {
                    if (B[i][j] >= '1' && B[i][j] <= '9') {
                        network.link(layerIdx[step][i][j], layerIdx[T + 1][i][j], B[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] == 'Y' || A[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (B[i][j] >= '1' && B[i][j] <= '9') {
                    network.link(layerIdx[T + 1][i][j], sink, B[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println((int) network.flow(source, sink));
    }
}
